That's also bribery (receiving money in exchange for using his position). So overall "受贿".

The defendant may be liable for "滥用职权" (abuse of power) and possibly "受贿" if he received money. The facts: He accepted cash from companies for helping them get projects (first part). That's bribery. The second part: He colluded to approve false projects, which is abuse of power. The label list includes "滥用职权". Also there is "受贿" already. So final answer should be "受贿;滥用职权".
